overview_description.description: Primo is an on-demand information-providing application designed to connect customers with various service providers. Their application connects with verified technicians, electricians, and handymen that offer repair, maintenance, refurbishing, and plumbing services, thereby enabling customers to compare and review service providers and receive competitive bids for their requests.

product.name: Primo Application
product.description: A mobile application providing a directory of industrialists and service providers such as electricians, plumbers, and home decor specialists.

product.name: Service Provider Directory
product.description: A categorized listing of service providers and industrialists across various trades and businesses.

product.name: Service Request and Notification System
product.description: A system that notifies service providers about available jobs and allows users to request services quickly.

product.name: Service Provider Evaluation and Rating
product.description: A feature that allows users to rate and review service providers after job completion.

product.description: A section offering articles and videos related to trades and crafts for skill development and knowledge sharing.
